query: Which professional baseball player and National 1993 Baseball Hall of Fame inductee is featured in the Greatest Sports Legends anthology?

pipeline_result.response: Reggie Jackson, a former professional baseball right fielder who played for several MLB teams including the Kansas City/Oakland Athletics, Baltimore Orioles, New York Yankees, and California Angels, is featured in the Greatest Sports Legends anthology. He was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in 1993.
retrieved_context: Greatest Sports Legends: Greatest Sports Legends is a sports anthology series on the lives and careers of noted athletes.  First aired in 1972, the series was produced with 10 new episodes per year nestled amongst 42 reruns.  207 episodes were produced, with athlete hosts including Michael Jordan,Tom Seaver, Paul Hornung, Reggie Jackson, Steve Garvey and Celebrity Hosts George Plimpton, Ken Howard and Jayne Kennedy interviewing the featured athlete.  The series won one Emmy award out of three nominations.

Reggie Jackson: Reginald Martinez "Reggie" Jackson (born May 18, 1946) is an American former professional baseball right fielder who played 21 seasons for the Kansas City / Oakland Athletics, Baltimore Orioles, New York Yankees, and California Angels of Major League Baseball (MLB).  Jackson was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in 1993.
